coldRead.icp: Nurse manager / DON at a 25-bed rural hospital, reading once on a phone between shifts

undefinedTerms: peer review committee (who sits on it, how it is formed, who is the chair at a small hospital)
chief nursing officer (used in Key Takeaways and the table before it is defined in the After section)
good faith vs bad faith (bad faith defined only partly)
Quick Request form / Comprehensive Written Request form (named before explained)
licensing agency (which one imposes the $25,000 penalty)
Health and Safety Code chapters 257 and 258
regularly employs (how regular counts for agency or contract nurses)
unprofessional or criminal conduct (what counts as that on a unit)
peer review records (where kept, who sees them)
supervisor vs charge nurse vs DON vs CNO (which role the rule means at each step)
mondayActions: find our written safe harbor policy and read it
name the committee chair and post the phone number next to the Quick Request forms
count our nurses against the eight-nurse threshold, including agency and contract
brief charge nurses that a spoken request is written down and signed by both people on the spot
look at the next schedule for shifts that are already short
tell charge nurses the forms go to the chair the next working day, not the Board
blockedActions: look at contracting the review out to another entity (no example of who qualifies, what it costs, or how to start)
staff a committee that excludes the DON/CNO at a small hospital (post says leadership is ruled out, never says who is eligible instead)
name the committee chair when our hospital may have no standing committee (no step for 'we have none')
find the written policy when we may not have one (not addressed)
collaborate with a nurse who refuses on skill grounds to find an acceptable assignment (no how, and unclear whether to add staff or keep the request open)
